dct_description_sm: The purpose of this study was to improve our understandings of how CO2, heat, water vapour and momentum are exchanged in an Arctic flaw lead/polynya system. During the 2007-2008 CFL IPY Project, the research icebreaker CCGS Amundsen overwintered in the South Beaufort Sea/Amundsen Gulf flaw lead system.  The purpose of this experiment was to comprehensively study the flaw lead system through an entire annual cycle.
dct_title_s: Ship-Based Eddy Covariance Data, 2007-2008 CFL IPY Project
